sources.title: PDF MAIM: a mixer MLP architecture for image matching - Springer
sources.snippet: This paper presents a novel Mixer-WMLP structure, which utilizes the latest advances in MLP backbone archi-tecture to construct a hybrid MLP structure with a global receptive field. Based on this model, we first propose an detector-free image-matching method using a mixer MLP structure, called A Mixer MLP Architecture for image-matching (MAIM).
